name: spor
description: Puts back what Claude Code folds away: the files Claude read and the commands it searched with, under each folded run, and what each turn did on its closing line

namesColor.title: Names color
namesColor.description: The files and commands named under each folded run: a theme role such as inactive (the default, Claude Code's color for hints and timestamps), claude or success; or a color: #7aa2f7, rgb(122,162,247), ansi256(110) or ansi:cyan

tallyColor.title: Tally color
tallyColor.description: What each turn did, under its closing line: a theme role such as inactive (the default, Claude Code's color for hints and timestamps), claude or success; or a color: #7aa2f7, rgb(122,162,247), ansi256(110) or ansi:cyan
